queries.name: identity
queries.sql: SELECT current_database() AS database,current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS read_only,now() AS snapshot_time

queries.name: other_cached_record_ids_targeting_candidates
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS count FROM asset_keys WHERE NOT(asset_key=ANY(%s)) AND (last_materialization::jsonb->>'storage_id')=ANY(%s)

queries.name: other_check_indexes_targeting_absent_cache_ids
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS count FROM asset_check_executions WHERE NOT(asset_key=ANY(%s)) AND (materialization_event_storage_id=ANY(%s::bigint[]) OR evaluation_event_storage_id=ANY(%s::bigint[]))

queries.name: other_raw_checks_targeting_absent_cache_ids
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS count FROM event_logs WHERE dagster_event_type='ASSET_CHECK_EVALUATION' AND NOT((event::jsonb#>>'{dagster_event,event_specific_data,asset_key,path}')=ANY(%s)) AND (event::jsonb#>>'{dagster_event,event_specific_data,target_materialization_data,storage_id}')=ANY(%s)

queries.name: absent_cache_ids_in_event_logs
queries.sql: SELECT id,asset_key,dagster_event_type FROM event_logs WHERE id=ANY(%s::bigint[])

queries.name: shared_snapshots
queries.sql: SELECT snapshot_id,count(*) AS referencing_run_count,count(*) FILTER (WHERE run_id=ANY(%s)) AS candidate_run_count FROM runs WHERE snapshot_id=ANY(%s) GROUP BY snapshot_id ORDER BY snapshot_id

queries.name: retained_run_tags
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS count FROM run_tags WHERE run_id=ANY(%s)
